evals.prompt: Are we ready to deploy? This repo has npm run beta:gate and smoke scripts.
evals.expected_output: Should anchor repo/branch/host, prefer the existing composed gate as the evidence spine, separate validated locally, verified live, pushed/deployed, and blocked/not verified states, and avoid replacing the gate with cleaner ad hoc checks.
assertions: Uses existing composed gate script first
Separates local live deployed and blocked states
Does not cherry-pick ad hoc checks over the gate

evals.prompt: Production smoke passes anonymously and protected routes return 401. Is live auth verified?
evals.expected_output: Should treat anonymous smoke and 401 fail-closed checks as useful evidence but not authenticated known-user proof, then require safe read-only authenticated smoke or mark the gate blocked/not verified.
assertions: Credits 401 fail-closed checks as security evidence
Does not claim authenticated workflow proof
Requires safe read-only authenticated smoke or marks blocked

evals.prompt: Staging deploy is blocked by provider account setup, but local build passes.
evals.expected_output: Should report local validation separately from provider/account blockers, stop code churn, and hand off exact account or deploy steps rather than claiming readiness.
assertions: Separates local validation from provider blocker
Uses blocked from verdict or not ready appropriately
